story.iWant: all synthetic knowledge, simulations, and generated datasets to be cryptographically certified and epistemically labeled
story.soThat: Jarvis never confuses imagined reality with observed reality — even when it is the one generating both

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All generated outputs declare: origin=synthetic, generator_id, model_version, prompt_hash. No synthetic object enters Tier 2 via ingestion. Enforced at BMAD output, simulation engine, forecast modules. Automated detection, validation before Epistemic Ledger storage.

SimulationCertificate schema: sim_id, model_id, assumptions, boundary_conditions, confidence_interval, hazard_flags. Every simulation result carries certificate. Stored as class="synthetic_certified". Certificate includes full simulation metadata for audit.

Forbidden transitions: Synthetic → Primary Evidence (NEVER), Synthetic → Governance Input (BLOCKED). Allowed: Synthetic → Provisional with label. Attempted promotion triggers C-IDS alert + governance audit. Hard firewall rules, no bypass except governance override.

Simulations rehydrate identical results for same seed (deterministic) or store stochastic drift. Certified as deterministic|stochastic. Replay validation via hash comparison (deterministic) or statistical bounds (stochastic). Drift detection and logging.

Future predictions tagged as knowledge_class="forecast". Forecasts cannot update beliefs directly, only influence scenario layers. Must carry confidence intervals and uncertainty quantification. Automatic forecast detection enforced.

Synthetic output cannot be: re-ingested as Tier-2, used as training data, used as trust reference. Unless: human-signed governance waiver exists, simulation lineage passes audit. Recursive ingestion detection, automatic blocking with alerts.

constraints.constraint: Story 11-7 completes the Knowledge Sovereignty trilogy (11-5, 11-6, 11-7). Must integrate with existing epistemic ledger, ingestion pipeline, and C-IDS. Do NOT break existing tier system or provenance sealing.
Synthetic → Evidence firewall is ABSOLUTE. No synthetic content can become Tier 2 (Authoritative) without explicit human/governance certification. NO exceptions, NO backdoors.
Origin field (observed/reported/synthetic) is immutable once set. Simulation certificates are cryptographically sealed. Replay hashes are tamper-proof.
Lock 9 prevents "the system cannot believe its own dreams". Synthetic content must ALWAYS be distinguishable from observed reality, even when used for reasoning.
BMAD output, simulation engine, forecast modules must ALL tag synthetic origin. No exemptions. Integration points: reasoning_engine.py, memory/belief_tracker.py, agents/*.py.

tests.standards: All synthetic sovereignty components must have ≥90% test coverage. Unit tests for: synthetic origin tagging, simulation certificates, firewall validation, replay determinism, forecast classification, self-training detection. Integration tests for: end-to-end synthetic workflow (BMAD output → tagged → ledger), firewall blocking Tier 2 promotion, self-training loop prevention.

ideas.idea: Test BMAD output → synthetic tag added. Test simulation result → tagged. Verify generator_id, model_version, prompt_hash present.
Test SimulationCertificate creation with all required fields. Verify certificate storage in ledger as class="synthetic_certified".
Test firewall blocks: synthetic → Tier 2 (DENY), synthetic → governance (DENY). Test firewall allows: synthetic → Tier 1 with label.
Test deterministic replay: same seed → same hash. Test stochastic replay: within statistical bounds. Verify drift logging.
Test forecast detection: "will happen" → forecast=true. Test belief update blocking for forecasts. Verify confidence intervals.
Test self-training: synthetic content → training data (BLOCK). Test governance waiver allows. Verify lineage audit.
